headline: Iran's leader repeats terms to end war as Brent settles near US$114
summary: The stories that stayed in the briefing most this week: Iran's leader repeats terms to end war as Brent settles near US$114; Bank of Canada decides Wednesday, with a hike to 2.50% widely expected; U.S. and Canada work on steel and auto tariff deal, possibly before midterms.

top.headline: Iran's leader repeats terms to end war as Brent settles near US$114
top.what: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei says the U.S. must meet Tehran's conditions before the war ends, a day after Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani security chiefs visited Tehran. Oil slipped for a second day but stays near its highest level since spring.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Bank of Canada decides Wednesday, with a hike to 2.50% widely expected
top.what: After seven straight holds at 2.25%, most economists and traders expect the Bank of Canada to raise its key rate by a quarter point on Wednesday as fuel prices push inflation to 3.1%.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: U.S. and Canada work on steel and auto tariff deal, possibly before midterms
top.what: Talks on easing U.S. tariffs on Canadian steel and autos are moving quickly at the political level, but Canadian sources doubt a deal lands before the November 3 midterms.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Chow re-elected; GTA voters oust mayors in Mississauga, Hamilton, Oakville and Milton
top.what: Olivia Chow won a second term as Toronto mayor, and final counts show voters across the region replaced several long-serving incumbents.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: UN inquiry calls Russia's energy strikes a crime against humanity
top.what: A UN commission says Russia's bombing of Ukraine's power system is a crime against humanity, as a local truce around occupied Oleshky holds and strikes continue elsewhere.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: A week out, Trump rallies in Texas as Senate race there tightens
top.what: With seven days to go, Trump campaigned in Texas for Senate nominee Ken Paxton, and a Fox News poll shows that race deadlocked. More than 30 million Americans have already voted.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Joly won't meet Stelco owner's CEO without a plan to restore jobs
top.what: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says she will only meet Cleveland-Cliffs CEO Lourenco Goncalves once the company produces a plan and timeline to bring back laid-off Stelco workers.
top.why: In the briefing on 6 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Chip rally lifts Nasdaq 1.1% as Boeing sinks ahead of the Fed
top.what: U.S. stocks closed higher Tuesday, led by chipmakers, while investors waited for Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision.
top.why: In the briefing on 5 of the last 7 days.
